subject: design/argus-problem-capture-attribution
statement: Keep the content-bound `Argus-Drive`/`Argus-Bind` pair on every drive-authored commit. Add only the active slug's working draft and compiled PRD/design and problem record subtrees to the author-independent first-PR grammar. During `draft prepare-lock`, refresh bindings on replayed commits that already carry a valid stamp, retain unstamped commits as unstamped, and leave the Pyxis-generated lock commit unstamped. Treat stamps as auditable authorship evidence in the current single-user workflow; the operator's exact-head review remains the authority for merge.
